preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 250.
The length of string S must be between 1 and 60.
The length of string P must be between 1 and 60.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Possible' if P == S + S else 'Impossible'
postconditions.description: If P is equal to S concatenated with itself, output 'Possible'; otherwise, output 'Impossible'.
